text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон crushes it at the Shuka
Sho, and the
audience is abuzz with
anticipation for a future
showdown
between her and the Beast, Narita
Brian,
who currently holds two Classic crowns.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
During the post-race press conference,
she
challenges Нарита Брайан to a
one-on-one at the
upcoming Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан watches the broadcast in
real time
and laughs to herself,
impressed—but not
intimidated.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
